status: Experimental Rust block-kind checkpoint verified; all 17 shipping release gates passed
scope: Guarded direct-root paragraph/heading kind changes, selection-driven action, exact in-memory history; no browser heading support

contract.schema: Separate sealed text-block profile with exact compiler-granted capability and required integer heading rank 1..6
contract.operation: TextBlockKindChange: nonempty contiguous root-child span, full source-node guards, one checked destination kind per source block
contract.action: SetTextBlockKindAction: configured no-input target, spatial selection span, excludes later block at zero-offset end
contract.history: One atomic undo unit; exact per-block inverse; stale or rejected changes preserve state and redo; new accepted edits replace redo
contract.validation: Fragment validation plus full bounded result-tree validation; no incremental structural proof shortcut
contract.actionState: Active/mixed/inactive remains accurate when resource limits disable an action; uniform-target no-op is disabled
contract.documentCodec: Document V2 retains validated heading properties
contract.durableOperationHistory: Deferred: V1-V3 operation/history codecs reject the new operation, including either session history branch
contract.checkpointTestBoundary: Reconstruction from already-proved in-memory checkpoint parts, not a durable heading-session round trip
